summary.text: K. Joseph Shekarchi is a Democrat who has represented House District 23 in Warwick since first being elected in November 2012, and who served as Speaker of the Rhode Island House of Representatives from January 2021 until stepping down from the role in May 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to his official biography, Shekarchi was first elected Speaker by his colleagues in January 2021 and re-elected in January 2023 and January 2025.
From November 2016 through 2020 he was House Majority Leader, and earlier he chaired the House Labor Committee.

The biography says he made housing a cornerstone of his agenda, including more than 60 housing bills and a $120 million affordable-housing bond approved by voters in 2024, and that health care was a major focus of the 2025 session.
Shekarchi graduated from Mount St. Charles Academy in 1980 and Suffolk University in 1984, and earned his law degree at Suffolk in 1990.
He has practiced law privately for more than 30 years, has been legal counsel to the Warwick Housing Authority for over 25 years, and is a former Warwick solicitor.
The biography describes him as a lifelong Warwick resident.
